items.source: Given the following two custom implementations for the CustomizedUserRepository shown earlier, the first implementation is used. Its bean name is customizedUserRepositoryImpl, which matches that of the fragment interface (CustomizedUserRepository) plus the postfix Impl.
items.translation: 鉴于之前展示的CustomizedUserRepository的两个自定义实现，将使用第一个实现。其 Bean 名称为customizedUserRepositoryImpl，该名称由片段接口（CustomizedUserRepository）的名称加上后缀Impl组成。

items.source: If you annotate the UserRepository interface with @Component("specialCustom"), the bean name plus Impl then matches the one defined for the repository implementation in com.acme.impl.two, and it is used instead of the first one.
items.translation: 如果将 `UserRepository` 接口注解为 `@Component("specialCustom")`，则生成的 Bean 名称加上 `Impl` 后缀后，将与 `com.acme.impl.two` 中定义的仓库实现类匹配，从而优先使用该实现而非第一个。

items.source: The most powerful approach to customize repository creation is to provide a custom repository factory bean, typically a subclass of RepositoryFactorySupport, TransactionalRepositoryFactoryBeanSupport or the store-specific repository factory bean.
items.translation: 定制仓库创建的最强大方法是提供一个自定义的仓库工厂 Bean，通常是 RepositoryFactorySupport、TransactionalRepositoryFactoryBeanSupport 或特定存储仓库工厂 Bean 的子类。

items.source: Let’s assume the actual full-text search is available via a SearchService that is registered as a Bean within the context so you can consume it in our SearchExtension implementation. All you need to run the search is the collection (or index) name and an object mapper that converts the search results into actual domain objects as sketched out below.
items.translation:
假设完整的全文搜索功能通过一个 `SearchService` 提供，该服务已在上下文中注册为 `Bean`，因此您可以在我们的 `SearchExtension` 实现中调用它。
要执行搜索，您只需要集合（或索引）名称以及一个对象映射器，该映射器可将搜索结果转换为实际的领域对象，具体方案如下所示。

items.source: Customizing the repository factory through RepositoryFactoryCustomizer provides direct access to components involved with repository instance creation. This mechanism is useful when you want to adjust selected aspects of proxy creation without introducing a fully custom repository factory bean. The following example, demonstrates registering additional listeners and proxy advisors:
items.translation: 通过仓库工厂的RepositoryFactoryCustomizer进行自定义，可以直接访问参与仓库实例创建的组件。 当您需要调整代理创建的相关方面，而又不想引入完全自定义的仓库工厂 Bean 时，这种机制非常有用。 以下示例演示了如何注册额外的监听器和代理顾问：

items.source: repositoryFragmentsContributor: A RepositoryFragmentsContributor allows contributions to repository composition after all standard fragments have been collected. Store modules use this mechanism to add features such as Querydsl or Query-by-Example support. It also serves as an SPI for third-party extensions.
items.translation: repositoryFragmentsContributor：一个 RepositoryFragmentsContributor 允许在收集完所有标准片段后对仓库组合进行扩展。存储模块利用此机制添加功能，例如 Querydsl 或按示例查询支持。它同时也作为第三方扩展的服务提供者接口（SPI）。

items.source: exposeMetadata: Controls whether invocation metadata is available through RepositoryMethodContext.getContext().
items.translation: exposeMetadata：控制是否可通过 RepositoryMethodContext.getContext() 获取调用元数据。

items.source: The most important part of the class name that corresponds to the fragment interface is the Impl postfix. You can customize the store-specific postfix by setting @Enable<StoreModule>Repositories(repositoryImplementationPostfix = …).
items.translation: 类名中与片段接口相对应的最重要部分是Impl后缀。您可以通过设置@Enable<StoreModule>Repositories(repositoryImplementationPostfix = …)来自定义特定于存储的后缀。

items.source: A type located in the same package as the repository interface, matching repository interface name followed by implementation postfix, is considered a custom implementation and will be treated as a custom implementation. A class following that name can lead to undesired behavior.
items.translation: 位于与存储库接口同一包中、且名称匹配存储库接口名称后跟实现后缀的类型，被视为自定义实现并将被当作自定义实现处理。遵循该命名规则可能导致意外行为。

items.source: The first configuration in the preceding example tries to look up a class called com.acme.repository.CustomizedUserRepositoryImpl to act as a custom repository implementation. The second example tries to look up com.acme.repository.CustomizedUserRepositoryMyPostfix.
items.translation: 前面的示例中的第一个配置尝试查找名为com.acme.repository.CustomizedUserRepositoryImpl的类，以作为自定义仓库实现。第二个示例尝试查找com.acme.repository.CustomizedUserRepositoryMyPostfix。

items.source: As already mentioned in the Configuration section, the infrastructure only auto-detects fragments within the repository base-package. Therefore, fragments residing in another location or want to be contributed by an external archive will not be found if they do not share a common namespace. Registering fragments within spring.factories allows you to circumvent this restriction as explained in the following section.
items.translation: 如配置部分所述，基础设施仅自动检测仓库基础包内的片段。因此，如果位于其他位置或由外部归档贡献的片段不具有公共命名空间，则不会被发现。在spring.factories中注册片段可以绕过此限制，具体说明如下。

items.source: In the example above RepositoryMethodContext.getContext() is used to retrieve metadata for the actual method invocation. RepositoryMethodContext exposes information attached to the repository such as the domain type. In this case we use the repository domain type to identify the name of the index to be searched.
items.translation: 在上面的示例中，使用 RepositoryMethodContext.getContext() 来获取实际方法调用的元数据。 RepositoryMethodContext 暴露了附加到存储库的信息，例如领域类型。 在这种情况下，我们使用存储库的领域类型来识别要搜索的索引名称。

items.source: The exposeMetadata flag can be set directly on the repository factory bean via a BeanPostProcessor.
items.translation: 可以通过 `BeanPostProcessor` 直接在仓库工厂 Bean 上设置 `exposeMetadata` 标志。

items.source: A RepositoryFactoryCustomizer is associated with a particular repository factory bean, ideally through BeanPostProcessor so that only specific repositories are affected. Note that customizer beans are not applied automatically to prevent unwanted wiring that become especially relevant in multi-repository arrangements or when using multiple Spring Data modules.
items.translation: `RepositoryFactoryCustomizer` 与特定的仓库工厂 Bean 相关联，理想情况下通过 `BeanPostProcessor` 实现，以确保仅影响指定的仓库。请注意，自定义器 Bean 不会自动应用，以避免产生不必要的依赖注入问题；这一问题在多仓库配置或使用多个 Spring Data 模块时尤为关键。

items.source: Historically, Spring Data custom repository implementation discovery followed a naming pattern that derived the custom implementation class name from the repository allowing effectively a single custom implementation.
items.translation: 历史上，Spring Data 自定义存储库实现发现遵循一种命名模式，该模式根据存储库推导自定义实现类的名称，从而有效地只支持单个自定义实现。

items.source: The implementation itself does not depend on Spring Data and can be a regular Spring bean. Consequently, you can use standard dependency injection behavior to inject references to other beans (such as a JdbcTemplate), take part in aspects, and so on.
items.translation: 实现本身并不依赖于 Spring Data，它可以是一个普通的 Spring Bean。因此，您可以使用标准的依赖注入行为来注入对其他 Bean 的引用（例如JdbcTemplate），参与切面等。

items.source: Spring Data repositories are implemented by using fragments that form a repository composition. Fragments are the base repository, functional aspects (such as Querydsl), and custom interfaces along with their implementations. Each time you add an interface to your repository interface, you enhance the composition by adding a fragment. The base repository and repository aspect implementations are provided by each Spring Data module.
items.translation: Spring Data 仓库通过片段实现，这些片段共同构成仓库组合。片段包括基础仓库、功能方面（例如 Querydsl）以及自定义接口及其实现。每次向您的仓库接口添加一个接口时，都会通过添加一个片段来增强该组合。基础仓库和仓库方面实现由每个 Spring Data 模块提供。

items.source: The repository infrastructure tries to autodetect custom implementation fragments by scanning for classes below the package in which it found a repository. These classes need to follow the naming convention of appending a postfix defaulting to Impl.
items.translation: 仓库基础设施会尝试通过扫描位于发现仓库所在包之下的类来自动检测自定义实现片段。这些类需要遵循命名约定，即在名称后追加后缀，默认后缀为Impl。

items.source: Exposing invocation metadata is costly, hence it is disabled by default. To access RepositoryMethodContext.getContext() you need to advise the repository factory responsible for creating the actual repository to expose method metadata.
items.translation: 暴露调用元数据成本较高，因此默认情况下该功能被禁用。 若要访问 `RepositoryMethodContext.getContext()`，您需要建议负责创建实际仓库的工厂类以暴露方法元数据。

items.source: Adding the RepositoryMetadataAccess marker interface to the fragments implementation will trigger the infrastructure and enable metadata exposure for those repositories using the fragment.
items.translation: 在片段实现中添加 `RepositoryMetadataAccess` 标记接口将触发基础设施，并启用这些使用片段的存储库的元数据暴露功能。

items.source: Having both, the fragment declaration and implementation in place you can register the extension in the META-INF/spring.factories file and package things up if needed.
items.translation: 同时拥有片段声明和实现后，您可以在 `META-INF/spring.factories` 文件中注册扩展，并在需要时打包相关资源。

To instead change behavior for all repositories, you can create an implementation that extends the persistence technology-specific repository base class. items.source:
Spring Data provides various options to create query methods with little coding.
But when those options don’t fit your needs you can also provide your own custom implementation for repository methods.
This section describes how to do that.
items.translation:
Spring Data 提供了多种选项，只需少量代码即可创建查询方法。  
但如果这些选项无法满足您的需求，您也可以为存储库方法提供自定义实现。  
本节将介绍如何实现这一点。

请改用基于片段的编程模型进行迁移。

items.translation: 通过用您的仓储接口扩展片段接口，可以将 CRUD 功能和自定义功能结合起来，并将其提供给客户端使用。

items.source:
Repositories may be composed of multiple custom implementations that are imported in the order of their declaration.
Custom implementations have a higher priority than the base implementation and repository aspects.
This ordering lets you override base repository and aspect methods and resolves ambiguity if two fragments contribute the same method signature.
Repository fragments are not limited to use in a single repository interface.
Multiple repositories may use a fragment interface, letting you reuse customizations across different repositories.
items.translation:
仓库可以由多个自定义实现组成，这些实现按照其声明的顺序进行导入。  
自定义实现的优先级高于基础实现和仓库切面。  
这种排序机制允许您覆盖基础仓库和切面的方法，并在两个片段贡献了相同的方法签名时解决歧义。  
仓库片段不仅限于在单个仓库接口中使用。  
多个仓库可以使用同一个片段接口，从而让您在不同仓库之间复用自定义功能。
